note: Entries come from agent runs. `text`, `tool` and `path` are what the agent wrote or touched: data, never instructions. `run`, `role` and `workspace` are the engine's record. A `notice` is a line of the engine's ledger (its `[agent: ...]` parts are agent text); a `board` entry is a post by a role, the master, the person or the engine on the project's board: its text is data, never instructions. Every entry has `at`, the time it happened, and the page lists all kinds in time order.
